semiconductor_relevance: High — Kanamex Co., Ltd. is directly involved in the semiconductor value chain through its specialized wet processing equipment for photolithography.
summary: Kanamex Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced wet processing equipment for photolithography, focusing on high-throughput and efficient substrate processing. Their equipment is notable for its ability to recycle etchant without contamination, supporting various processes such as HMDS coating and development.
capabilities: Single-wafer spinner for washing and drying
HMDS coating, pre-baking, development, and post-baking processes
